steps.title: Start with 2 panels and 2 rails
steps.instruction: Join 2 panels and 2 rails (A, B, C, D), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the ÄPPLARÖ chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 65 cm), B (panel, about 50 cm), C (rail, about 50 cm), D (rail, about 50 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
